name: smwmusic-pok-mon-heartgold-soulsilver-cerulean-city-fuchsia-city
title: Pokémon HeartGold/SoulSilver - Cerulean City / Fuchsia City
description:
The lovely theme from everyone's favourite blue and pink towns in the Kanto region, so comfortingly remixed in Generation IV.

This song is so dear and special to me, and has been ever since I was a little child. It's a shame it got shafted so hard in the original Generation II games. So here's me doing my part to give this song the love it deserves.
